output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount), 2) AS discontinued_revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE p.is_active = false
  AND o.is_revenue = true
output.explanation: This adds up the net line amounts for every product marked as no longer active (is_active = false), which is how I identified discontinued products. It covers all dates in the data. Only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue = true) are counted, so orders that don't count as revenue are left out. I used the line-level net amount rather than order totals because an order can mix discontinued and active products. The result is a single figure rounded to 2 decimals.
